main.description: A series of posts on skiddle.id. The record key is the series' slug, e.g. from-fear-to-flight. Posts point at it from their id.skiddle.post content.

ongoing.description: A series with no last part, like a weekly one: it shows how often new parts come out instead of 'part 3 of 3'.

cadence.description: How often new parts come out, e.g. 'every week'.

planned.description: Parts that are planned but not published yet. A published post with the same part number takes a planned part's place.

coverImage.description: The series' share card, drawn when the series is saved. Named like site.standard.document's.
